page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top with page number 392 at the left. Below the text, a catchword-like signature "AUCTORI" at the right, set in small capitals. No margin notes.

main_text.p: In quarta, Generaliora sphalmata Domini Cl. in relatione sua de Oeconomia mea Divina.
In quinta, Specialiora sphalmata ejusdem in eadem de Oeconomia Divina relatione.
In sexta, de articulo quodam Præfationis Tomi V. Bibliothecæ Universalis, & de convicio quodam in Tomo sequenti.
In septima, quantum fidei Domini Cl. relationibus de aliorum libris sit habendum, aliquot exemplis ostenditur.
In octava, de ejus in sanctiores Ecclesiæ Patres, præsertim in S. Augustinum invectivarum perpetuarum causis, fide & æquitate, nec non de ejusdem irrisorio genio agitur.
In nona denique, plura esse in ejus scriptis & propositis irridenda & carpenda, quam quæ in aliis ipse irrisit & carpsit; sed optandum alia & Christianis magis digna methodo dedoceri errores.

page.notes: Printed in a mix of roman and italic type; the word "AUCTORI" at the lower right is a signature-like catchword, placed here as a bottom element. Scan shows show-through and speckle, which were omitted.
